fnol_text: My name is Ravi Ballard and I live at 779 Alder Road, Greenville, SC 29686. You can reach me on (555) 673-7540 or ravi.ballard@example.com. On 3 October 2024 another car pulled out of a side road and hit my front passenger side. The other driver, Priya Takahashi, admitted they didn't see me. Policy MT-2023-00147. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Ballard on (555) 673-7540 to acknowledge the claim. Ravi confirmed the loss date as 3 October 2024.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Leila Moreau gave a statement by phone.
Third-party driver Priya Takahashi reports a sprained wrist and attended County General. Ravi reports lower back strain.
